summary: Problem Brief Form (ProblemBriefForm.jsx) frontend testing completed successfully. All 11 form fields present and working. Form renders correctly when navigating to /talent/build/new (or any unit's /build/new route). Unit-specific title displays correctly. Required field validation works. Trigger and Frequency dropdowns reveal conditional inputs when needed. Systems & Tools tag selector toggles correctly. Voice recording button is visible and ready. Submit button correctly disabled until all required fields AND voice note are recorded. Chat input is hidden when form is showing.
